root_cause.text: `qfq_reset_qdisc` incorrectly determines whether a class is active by checking the queue length of its leaf qdisc (`cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0`), which can be shared with another class, leading to the erroneous deactivation of an inactive class and a subsequent NULL pointer dereference in `qfq_deactivate_agg`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `if (cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0)` with `if (cl_is_active(cl))` in `qfq_reset_qdisc` to prevent wrongly deactivating an inactive class when two `qfq_class` objects share the same `leaf_qdisc`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix class deactivation during QFQ reset by using the proper active state helper instead of checking queue length.
intent_record.what: Replaced the direct queue length check `cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0` with the helper function `cl_is_active(cl)` in `qfq_reset_qdisc`.
intent_record.how: Ensures that class deactivation during a QFQ reset is determined by the actual active state of the class rather than just its queue length.
